question: What supreme Eye of the two Śivas is honored as illumination-natured and possessing all powers?
premises: The Eye is of the nature of illumination.
The Eye belongs to the two Śivas and is supreme.
inference: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, which is illumination itself and endowed with all powers.
uncertainties: The identity of the two Śivas is not specified in this unit.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all powers.
